description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint for retrieving employee directory information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for fetching single employee details and searching employee lists, leveraging various parameters and models. The class also manages validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class providing access to employee directory data, supporting retrieval of individual employee details and search functionality with various filter parameters. Implements validation and documentation for the API operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches details of a single employee based on employee number, returning the appropriate model (default or detailed) as requested.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees based on search filters like employee number, name or ID, job title, and location, supporting pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryService
methods.description: Provides an instance of the EmployeeDirectoryService used to access employee data.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the response model class (default or detailed) based on the request parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, including entity existence check.

methods.name: getModelParamRule
methods.description: Provides validation rule for the 'model' query parameter, ensuring it is within allowed values.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for filtering parameters in the 'getAll' endpoint.
